column1: # s3-tests expected to fail for the backend's sake when the backend is the
# in-process one (s3gw/localbackend), and why (test <TAB> reason). run.sh
# hands this file to triage.py when the backend endpoint is "memory" or
# "directory:PATH". It replaces the "Backend:" name heuristics, which
# describe Ceph RGW: on this backend such a failure must be listed here, and
# a listed test must fail, so the list is exact for the pinned suite commit.
# The gateway's own refusals (501s, ACLs, SigV2, ...) are still sorted by
# triage.py's rules, the same on every backend.
#   s3       localbackend answers as Amazon S3 does (its documentation, or
#            the AWS fidelity suite), where this suite expects RGW's answer
#   rgw      an RGW behavior localbackend does not imitate, with no evidence
#   gateway  the gateway's doing, sorted here only by the test's name
